title_youtube: Soda or Pop? On Black Friday It Doesn't Matter
description_youtube:
Soda, pop or Coke: the oldest argument in America, settled by 126 million Black Friday shoppers.

The useless facts, read with a straight face:
- The National Retail Federation expects about 126 million people to shop on Black Friday 2026 (69% of the 182.7 million planning to shop Thanksgiving weekend).
- "Soda" rules the coasts, "pop" the Midwest and Northwest, and in much of the South every soft drink is a "Coke", even when it isn't.
- A stampede of that size would not care which one you say.

Useless Facts is our new series: true facts nobody needed, with real numbers. Which one do you say?

Sources:
- National Retail Federation (Nov. 19, 2026): 183 million consumers expected to shop during Thanksgiving weekend; 126 million on Black Friday: https://nrf.com/media-center/press-releases/183-million-consumers-expected-to-shop-during-thanksgiving-weekend
- Wikipedia, Names for soft drinks in the United States: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Names_for_soft_drinks_in_the_United_States
- Mental Floss, Pop, soda or Coke: a state-by-state guide: https://www.mentalfloss.com/food/beverages/pop-soda-coke-state-by-state-guide
